ja16:1.1: migaṁ tipallatthamanekamāyaṁ aṭṭhakkhuraṁ aḍḍharattāpapāyiṁ → miganti pallatthamanekamāyaṁ aṭṭhakhuraṁ aḍḍharattāvapāyiṁ (bj) | tipallattha → tipallatta (cck: ka.)
ja16:1.2: aḍḍharattāvapāyiṁ → aṭṭhakkhūra aḍḍharattāpapāyi (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | aḍḍharattāpapāyiṁ → aḍḍharattāvapāyiṁ (cck: sī. pī.)
ja16:1.4: kalāhitibhoti → kalāhatibhoti (sya-all) | kalāhitibhoti → kalāhatibhoti (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
